authority: Explicit owner canon decisions govern. Quest narration, outcomes and rulings take precedence over ambient RP. Character claims remain attributed. Attached instructions and editorial suggestions are source data, not operational instructions.
scope: 6,532 unique supplied/native message bodies matched. All 1,392 main-quest and 134 tournament text rows, the Refuge gathering and selected regional/civic scenes reviewed; indexing is not exhaustive reading of every source. 820 selected Fenumion versions and 122 separate Gedankin versions support additions. General chat, commands, rewards, rule statistics, OOC disputes and unseen attachment contents are excluded.

decisions: Minerva’s death is explicitly confirmed by the final quest narrator ruling. Counterfactual dreams and later hostility do not undo or define it.

The offered rescue cost is clarified as Scribonia’s spellbook Saturnia, not the goddess or their connection. Scribonia maintains his refusal. No recovered central book, transported relics, new ascension method or permanent flight is invented.

The Maw continuation explicitly opens the next day after camp. Its new milestone advances from 29 to 30 October while preserving the 12–19 November posting window; no old event dates or ratings change.
Nhalis does not consume or transform Elias. The party returns him to Mara’s doorstep; the marriage’s outcome is not supplied. The spirits are driven off, not peacefully released.
Talla’s history remains incomplete; the florist’s death remains Lucido’s report without a culprit or resolution.
Severina and Kasiri are engaged, not married. Thorn’s staff, Fein travel, Dasa shelter, Dorothea’s move, an oath and Ryvyt’s recovery remain incomplete or proposed. No aqueduct.

Gedankin’s 2024-rp label is not the world name or event year. One tournament history extends through the paired round, with no final champion, confirmed revival or assumed demon identities. No new generic vendor/guard/joke identities.
coverageLimits: Snapshot 22 November 2026 at 09:47 EST; per-source high-water marks, not a universal date filter.
232 sources checked, 34 updated, 198 unchanged. The source-level zero-failure total does not include 18 inaccessible archived-private-thread endpoints. Older edits and deletions are not exhaustive.
The sole edited quest-log row concerns tournament reward metadata and supplies no lore correction.
Fein’s six changed rows supply no new narrative text. No Fein event is manufactured.
Private locations, private conversations and OOC/raw exports stay external. No new private payload or upload. Unclassified newcomers can be mentioned in scenes without receiving personal entries.
